rationale: This is a pure lookback-window tweak (5→3 years) of the archived gen-0 winner with no new economic content, and the stated coverage motivation is likely wrong since the binding sample constraint in that signal is the oancf history requirement that this variant only marginally relaxes while COALESCE already makes the R&D leg universal.

The swap from a cash-flow floor to a downside net-margin floor is a genuinely different economic channel (product-market durability vs. funding capacity) and the income-statement alignment of both legs is well-argued, though the components individually flirt with known R&D-to-sales and earnings-stability/quality anomalies so the novelty rests entirely on the weakest-link conjunction.

This is essentially the archived Externally Financed Intangible Build with the funding leg sign-flipped and re-centered using the 0.5-subtraction trick already deployed in another archived gen-0 signal, and the stated mechanics are inconsistent — because the build leg is an uncentered IND_RANK, firms scored near zero are the largest intangible *shrinkers*, not the "no build" firms the reasoning claims are neutralized.

The bounded intangible-vs-depreciation composition ratio is a legitimately new and scale-free construct that is not a simple restatement of R&D-to-assets, but the claimed coverage improvement is unfounded since the retained five-year oancf floor (plus a new dp requirement) remains the binding sample constraint.

Nesting MIN over the legs of two already-archived positive signals is mechanical stacking rather than a new mechanism, and since the added retained-earnings leg is monotone in the same quality direction it will mostly just shrink the long portfolio to firms already selected by the existing weakest-link signal.

Substituting a balance-sheet slack stock for the cash-flow flow floor is a clean one-factor discrimination between two competing interpretations of the gen-0 result and should genuinely expand coverage, though net-working-capital-to-assets overlaps with known working-capital and financial-constraint effects, so the test hinges on the conjunction outperforming its legs.
